name: Gyakushuu
source:
A small country is defeated by overwhelming Empire forces. The defense was memorable by female Julia who struck down numerous number of impostors before fleeing the country.
After the conquest is finished Emperor swears to take her life and organizes search. On a moonlit night he burns a black heart in a ritual to find out her location. The assault begins now.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一座弹丸小国在大帝国压倒性的铁蹄下宣告覆灭。然而在此前的卫国战中，英姿飒爽的女剑士尤莉娅大显神威，接连斩杀无数帝国侵略兵后才突围逃离故国。
吞并小国后，对此怀恨在心的帝国皇帝立誓要取她性命，下令全国通缉搜捕。某个清冷的月夜，皇帝在邪恶仪式上焚烧了一颗漆黑心脏，借此占卜出了尤莉娅的藏身之地——一场残酷的凌虐追袭就此打响。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
